title: Evaluation of a realistic training model for laparoscopic myomectomies
summary: Minimally invasive surgery has become an integral part of gynecology. In order to train prospective or aspiring gynecological surgeons and to make this efficient and safe in everyday clinical practice, it is important to be able to offer suitable training models for demanding surgical procedures. Therefore, in this study, a uterus model with a myoma lying in the uterine wall will be tested for its realism in a laparoscopic surgical simulation. Experienced and inexperienced surgeons will be compared for this type of procedure. Physicians from the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics at the Mainz University Medical Center are eligible to participate.
